prompt:
In many large cities, homes near the centre have become so expensive that the people who work there have to live a long way away.

What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both questions must be answered separately: first the problems, then the measures.
At least two concrete problems: long commuting time, transport cost, and difficulty finding staff for jobs in the centre.
The problems can be split at the individual and city level (tiredness / disruption of services).
The measures must match the problems: building affordable housing, rent regulation, spreading workplaces outside the centre, and a transport link.
It should be stated who would carry out each measure (local government, employer).
common_mistakes: Writing the problems at length and giving the measures only one sentence.
Proposing general solutions unrelated to the problems.
Explaining why housing prices rose while skipping the two questions actually asked.
